target: acceptance 3 — the REVIEW STAGE must route hardened and refuse when the payload is absent. Wiring the resolver without wiring the stage leaves the acceptance unimplemented.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/review/SKILL.md"; calls=$(grep -c "tracker.sh profile" "$f"); refuse=$(grep -A12 "tracker.sh profile" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | grep -ci "payload is not installed"); nofall=$(grep -A20 "tracker.sh profile" "$f" | tr "\n" " " | grep -ci "not review it as .standard\|never.*fall back\|Do NOT review"); printf '{"calls":%s,"refuses":%s,"noFallback":%s}' "$calls" "$refuse" "$nofall"
